title: Canonical Who-Is broadcast discovery
purpose: Provide a compact, mutation-friendly discovery seed that exercises BACnet/IP outer framing and unconfirmed request parsing without requiring prior state.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP listener should accept the BVLC and NPDU framing and parse the APDU as an unconfirmed discovery request; devices may respond with I-Am on the network.
constraints_preserved: Single complete message rather than artificial fragments
BVLC header uses BACnet/IP style with total length matching actual byte count
NPDU version byte present and control byte set to a minimal no-routing form
APDU begins with unconfirmed-request PDU type high nibble 0x10 per supplied function code reference
Who-Is service-body details are omitted to keep the seed minimal and mutation-friendly where full source grammar is not provided
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid discovery analogue with no issue payloads and no exact historical collision material.
